problems: Blind guess missed the subject: it read as a heron or crane with a raised neck. The intended subject is an upright hand, which was only offered as an alternative. The silhouette does not read as a hand at a glance.

Fingers are thin, uneven loops. Middle (34752) and ring (32844) fingers pinch into a narrow wedge, and the little finger (33485) is a long spike, so the hand reads as a stalk rather than a palm with five digits.
Palm is too narrow and sits low. The two heel stars 36850 (~192,431) and 36366 (~220,435) sit at the bottom of a thin outline with no clear palm mass.
Wrist star 34693 (~313,470) is off the hand. The arm outline runs down to ~355,515 as a detached stub, which reads as a tail or beak.
The kite 33018 (~402,377) sits in a separate loop that touches the right edge of the palm. It reads as a detached blob, not a kite on a string.
Labels for 36850 and 36366 overlap ('heel of the palm, left side' collides with 'heel of the palm, right side'), so the part names are hard to read.

Stars are on the right parts. Thumb tip 37946 (~140,295), thumb base 37265 (~171,366), index tip 35710 (~256,315), middle tip 34752 (~304,253), ring tip 32844 (~397,187) and little tip 33485 (~361,108) all sit at the ends of their digits. The figure is upright, with fingers up and wrist down. The gold lines are a constellation overlay, not a copy of the outline.
